hagicode.heading: What if Hagicode amplified your efficiency?
hagicode.subtitle: Treat Hagicode as an accelerator that first amplifies your subjective productivity, then improves token utilization through a more standardized OpenSpec workflow. Move the two sliders and we immediately recompute coworker threat and AI value under this revised model.
hagicode.sliderHint: Slide between 1.5 and 10 to amplify your subjective productivity first.
hagicode.utilizationHint: Slide between 1.1 and 2.0. Higher utilization means OpenSpec reduces rework, misuse, and hallucination, so actual token spend gets diluted under the same target output.
hagicode.modelFormula: New token spend = base {{base}} x Hagicode {{boost}} ÷ token utilization {{utilization}} = {{final}}. In other words, it first expands to {{raw}}, then standardized workflow efficiency pulls effective spend back down to {{final}}.

footer.disclaimer: This page helps illustrate how Agent workflows amplify individual output. The real risk is not AI alone, but colleagues who already use it as a repeatable system.
footer.extensionNote: The model prices, formulas, and conclusions on this page are for understanding Agent workflow cost and leverage only, not investment, hiring, or career advice.
